## What changes

<!-- Which documents, sections, schemas or test vectors change, and why. Link the issue or discussion. -->

## Kind of change

- [ ] Wording or examples only (no normative change)
- [ ] Compatible extension (new optional fields, routes, event types or a new capability; `PROTOCOL.md` §3)
- [ ] Breaking change (needs `/api/v2` or a new capability; discuss in an issue first)
- [ ] Test vectors added or corrected
- [ ] `openapi.json` regenerated by the reference node (`tavrn-node`), not edited by hand

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` and `scripts/check-spdx.sh` pass
- [ ] Every section that refers to the changed one is updated (search for its § number)
- [ ] The reference implementations are updated or an issue is open for them (`tavrn-node`, `tavrn-js`, `tavrn-crypto`, `tavrn-web`)
- [ ] I have read the [contributing guide](https://github.com/just-tavrn/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to the [CLA](../CLA.md) (the CLA bot asks on the first pull request)
